cues: Order and molecularity sound alike, but they are different ideas.
Order is the sum of the powers in the experimental rate law.
It can be zero, or even a fraction.
Molecularity is the number of species colliding in a single elementary step: one, two or three, always a whole number, never zero.
text: Order and molecularity sound alike, but they are different ideas. Order is the sum of the powers in the experimental rate law. It can be zero, or even a fraction. Molecularity is the number of species colliding in a single elementary step: one, two or three, always a whole number, never zero.
